title: fix(cli): os build leaves devPlugins out of the artifact; os validate --target stops reading it as code
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XR4fpPzKKft83b8NgK8NESr)_

Part of #31264 — this PR does items 1 and 3 and the cli half of item 2. The `RestrictionProfileSchema` docblock sentence (spec, `allowCode` rule) is left to the spec seat after this lands; the exact sentence is under "Spec docblock owed" below.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two accept-sets widen: `os validate --target` with `allowCode: false` now accepts a stack that declares `devPlugins`, and an unmanaged install (`os package install --install-mode unmanaged`, and the cloud-connection local installs) of a freshly built artifact of such a stack is no longer refused, because that artifact no longer carries the key. Leaving the key out of `objectstack.json` refuses nothing (measured below), so there is no narrowing arm.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os build` / `os compile` 写产物时去掉 `devPlugins`,和已经去掉的 `demoStaff` 同一处;`os validate --target` 在 `allowCode: false` 下不再把 `devPlugins` 当代码拒绝。
- 为什么改:`devPlugins` 只在本地 `--dev` 启动时从配置加载,产物里没有任何启动或安装会读它,但 `os package publish` / `os deploy` 会把产物原样送到目标环境,于是限制配置只能把它当代码拒掉。
- 风险与回滚:只是产物少一个开发用的键;`os dev` / `os serve --dev` 仍从配置加载它;旧产物带这个键照样能装。仓内没有读产物 `devPlugins` 的代码;cloud 仓本会话够不到,未能核验。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`(`delete finalBundle.devPlugins`),`packages/cli/src/utils/restriction-profile.ts`(`NEVER_REACHES_TARGET`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts test/build-demo-staff-artifact.test.ts`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`: the artifact write deletes `devPlugins` right after `demoStaff`, at the one place `objectstack.json` is written. `os build` is an alias of this command; `os package publish` (`dist/objectstack.json` or its argument) and `os deploy` (`DEPLOY_ARTIFACT`, after `compileForDeploy`) both read that file rather than the config, so dropping it at the write covers them.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/restriction-profile.ts`: `CODE_KEYS` (the keys `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` classifies `code`) now excludes a named set, `NEVER_REACHES_TARGET = {'devPlugins'}`, with the reason in its docblock and one line in the module header. The now-unreachable `devPlugins` branch of `codeItems` is removed. ⛔ `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` is unchanged: an unmanaged install still refuses `devPlugins` as code in a bundle that still carries the key (an artifact built before this change). A fresh build no longer carries it, so an unmanaged install of that artifact is no longer refused for it (the second widening on the Clause-② line).
- `content/docs/getting-started/quick-start.mdx`: the one docs sentence that lists what `os build` leaves out of `objectstack.json` (it named `demoStaff`) now names `devPlugins` too. The `os compile` section of `deployment/cli.mdx` lists no dropped keys, so it is unchanged.
- `.changeset/31264-build-drops-dev-plugins.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch (both files ship in the cli `dist/`).

## Tests

- `test/build-demo-staff-artifact.test.ts` (the existing artifact-drop pin for `demoStaff`): the fixture gains `devPlugins: ['@acme/legal-dev-only-plugin']`, the build runs once for both cases, and a new case asserts the key is absent from `objectstack.json` by key and by text, and absent from what `loadArtifactBundle` (the runtime's own loader) returns. Control: the stack's objects survive the same build; the `demoStaff` case still passes on the same build.
- `src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts`: under `allowCode: false`, a stack with `plugins` and `devPlugins` gets exactly one row, the `plugins` one.
- `test/validate-target-restriction-profile.test.ts` (the command's door, in-process): the fixture stack gains a `devPlugins` entry, and the `allowCode: false` case keeps its exact four rows, so the door pins that the dev-only plugin is not refused; the no-target and all-open controls stay green with the key present.
- Control for "`os dev --dev` still loads them": `stackBootPlugins` reads the config `serve` loads (`serve.ts`, `stackBootPlugins(config, flags.dev)`), untouched here; pinned by `src/utils/stack-collections.test.ts` and `src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.test.ts` (`--dev composes the config's devPlugins`), both in the cli unit tier run below.

<details><summary>Red first on origin/main 455229e7</summary>

A stack with `devPlugins: ['@acme/dev-only-plugin']` and a `demoStaff` entry, CLI from source (`bin/run-dev.js`):

- `os compile --json`: exit 0; `dist/objectstack.json` keys `manifest,objects,positions,devPlugins`, `devPlugins: ["@acme/dev-only-plugin"]`; `demoStaff` absent.
- `os validate --target profile.json --json` (`allowCode: false`): exit 1, one row `{ rule: 'allowCode', where: "dev plugin '@acme/dev-only-plugin'", path: 'devPlugins[0]' }`.

Same probe on the fix head: compile exit 0, keys `manifest,objects,positions`; validate exit 0, `valid: true`, no errors.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one leg per behaviour</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. Both suites import the subject from `src/` (in-process `Validate.run`, and `bin/run-dev.js` running the CLI from source), so no `dist/` leg applies.

- Reader: `new Set(['devPlugins'])` → `new Set([])` (blob 5dde1196cffb → 7c872933b460): 2 failed / 29 passed — the new reader case and the door's `allowCode: false` case.
- Artifact write: `delete finalBundle.devPlugins;` deleted (blob b65a74f758fb → 419934d0cafd): 1 failed / 1 passed — the `devPlugins` case red, the `demoStaff` case still green.
</details>

## Cross-repo check

`gh api -X GET search/code -f q='devPlugins org:objectstack-ai' --paginate`: 42 hits in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 3 in `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` — all three are `content/docs/administration/sandbox-and-releases{,.zh-Hans,.zh-Hant}.mdx`, a key list in docs prose, not a reader. **`objectstack-ai/cloud` is not reachable from this session** (`gh api repos/objectstack-ai/cloud` answers 403 "GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session"; `add_repo` answers "you don't have access"), so whether the cloud control plane reads `devPlugins` out of `sys_package_version.manifest_json` is **not measured**. In this repo no package outside `packages/cli` reads `devPlugins` off an artifact: `packages/spec` holds the schema (`stack.zod.ts`, optional), the dispositions table, the composition rule and the migration chain's relevance walk (`migrations/chain.ts`, which reads a listed `devPlugins` as "unknown" and with the key absent reads the stack's other keys); `packages/verify/src/harness.ts` only mentions it in a comment.

**Open residual:** whether `objectstack-ai/cloud` reads `devPlugins` out of `sys_package_version.manifest_json` stays open on #31264, for a seat with cloud access to measure.

## Spec docblock owed (for the spec seat)

On `RestrictionProfileSchema`'s `allowCode` docblock (`packages/spec/src/system/restriction-profile.zod.ts`), the sentence to add:

> `devPlugins` is not judged by `allowCode`: it is loaded only by a local development boot, and `os build` leaves it out of the artifact a target installs, so it never reaches a target; `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` still classifies it as `code` for an unmanaged install.

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-② arm, measured: the reader change widens the accept-set of `os validate --target` (a stack refused before is accepted). The artifact change narrows nothing: no door refuses anything new (every stack that compiled before still compiles), the stack schema still accepts `devPlugins` on an artifact (an artifact built before this change still installs and boots), and no reader in this repo loads the key from an artifact. Hence `yes (widening)`, matching the claim, with two widenings: the `--target` reader, and an unmanaged install of a fresh artifact (`package-unmanaged-install.ts` judges the bundle's keys against `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS`, and the key is no longer in the bundle). No dogfood battery is owed (no `(narrowing)` arm, no `!`).
- `os dev` and `os serve --dev` keep loading `devPlugins` from the config; `os dev --artifact` boots without a config and never loaded them, before or after.
- The build summary's `Runtime:` row still counts `devPlugins`: `collectMetadataStats` reads the loaded config, not the artifact.

## Verification

All on `2f7e23d754`, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli...' build`. Head `8f2196e851` adds one prose-only commit on top (the changeset body; `git diff --name-only 2f7e23d754..HEAD` = `.changeset/31264-build-drops-dev-plugins.md`), so no code, test or gate input moved; `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:empty-changeset` and `check:adr-0087-registration` were re-run on the new head (below).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts test/validate-target-restriction-profile.test.ts test/build-demo-staff-artifact.test.ts`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 33 passed (33).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 401 passed (401), Tests 5664 passed (5664). The integration tier is declared to CI; the one spawn-tier file this diff edits (`build-demo-staff-artifact.test.ts`) ran green in the run above.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0, test layer OK, debt unchanged.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the five touched TS files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 93 derived families, every one run with its exit captured before any pipe; all exit 0. `check:skill-examples` and `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: client SDK / example-config dist absent) and were re-run green after building those closures. `--ran`: 「93 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED」, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint on the touched files; the repo run is CI's).

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own convention).
